## Troubleshooting tips

If your PS5 does not detect or recognize you SSD, please check these things first.

1. Check your SSD SPEC, if Your SSD is M.2 NVMe Gen4x4 SSD. 2. Please make sure you fully plugged it hard to the expansion connector

3. Please check if your PS5 with the latest firmware

• Please make sure your software have been updated to the latest version (system software version 21.02-04 or higher).

##### For the PlayStation 5 and Hardcore Desktop Gamers: A95 and A93

##### If you are expanding your PS5 storage or building a top-tier gaming PC, thermal management is just as important as raw speed. The A95 features a premium 9.1mm shark-fin aluminum heatsink with a heat-conducting silica gel pad, ensuring it fits perfectly in the PS5 while preventing thermal throttling. The A93 offers slightly higher peak read speeds (7,400 MB/s) and utilizes an 8.75mm crosscut grid heatsink, making it another excellent, fully compatible choice for the PS5 and demanding desktop workloads. Both drives exceed Sony’s performance requirements.

...

##### Q1: Will a Gen4 SSD work in my older Gen3 motherboard?

##### Yes. All addlink PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSDs are fully backward compatible with PCIe Gen3x4 platforms. However, the maximum speed will be limited by the Gen3 interface (typically capping around 3,500 MB/s). It’s still a great upgrade path, as you can carry the Gen4 drive forward to a new system later.
